sessions.title: The neighbour check, calibrated
sessions.holds: A threshold can be right and the answer still wrong, when the quantity thresholded is not the quantity the duty is about — and that failure gives no sign of itself at all.

sessions.title: Reaching outside: Propp, and whether the move is in the field
sessions.holds: Before asking whether a measure separates a move from a subject, ask whether the move is in the field at all. Automation can establish that a field does not contain what it is named for, over a whole catalogue, by a rule anyone can check; it cannot supply what is missing.

sessions.title: Four checks with no dial, over every column of three catalogues
sessions.holds: The checks worth having are the ones with no dial, and they exist.

sessions.title: The line and the curve
sessions.holds: A statement holds exactly when its line lies outside the range of its curve. You never have to defend a setting — you have to publish the range.
